**DO NOT OPEN PUBLIC ISSUES FOR SECURITY PROBLEMS**

If you've found a security vulnerability, please report it privately:

**Email:** security@sindicato.report

This template is for tracking purposes only. For actual security reports, email directly.

**Description**
Brief description of the vulnerability.

**Severity**
- [ ] Critical (data breach, authentication bypass)
- [ ] High (privilege escalation, data exposure)
- [ ] Medium (limited impact)
- [ ] Low (cosmetic/minor)

**Status**
- [ ] Reported via email
- [ ] Acknowledged
- [ ] Fix in progress
- [ ] Fixed
